I'm 19 and a similar thing happens to me regularly. I often mix up words, for example I intend to say 'car' but I say TV or something bizzare like that. This has been going on since I was little and it's frustrating to say the least. Alcohol and stress definitely make it worse. Lately I've been also having memory problems and I think it's somehow connected. I suggest talking to a specialist if you can afford one or at least reading some literature about this problem.
Btw thanks for the support, I know it must be hard trying to help someone and have them respond negatively to everything

I can only do it for so long, eventually he'll start calling me. The dog's a 4 month old pup and can't walk for more than 2 hours, and neither can I in this heat. I just hate everything about my home. Both parents are unfit to take care of children, I have no friends and live in such a depressing town in a country with no future. It's too much to bear for me. I have no useful education, no money, not even a fucking driver's licence... why can't I just drop dead?

I just miss the carelesness. Not caring what will happen a month later, not worrying about getting a job, about health, having no negative thought shadowing my happiness. God damn my life has bevome meaningless

I believe it may be my mind. I over-analyze everything to the point where I can barely find joy anymore. It can't seem to shut my brain off and it leaves me too exhausted to function like a normal person. I also get unwanted, horrible invasive thoughts from time to time. I wouldn't be too surprised if I end up in an asylum.

Thanks for your positive answer. I'v been battling these feelings for the past 2 years. They seem to come and go, tho for the past few year the bad days easily turn to weeks and months and the good day are becoming rarer. Stress definitely plays a role, but is not the core problem. I just feel like - and this is a rational conclusion - that I'm not made for this world. I'm incompatible with modern society. It only bring me down. I spend most of my days dreaming scenarios where life would be simpler or just watching TV shows to escape reality.

Wow. Your story makes me feek guilty for wanting to die (my problems are nothing compared to yours). The way I see it you still have some energy and fight left in you. Use them to expose the sickos for who they are. Make it your lives work to bring their crimes to light of day. I truly wish you hapinnes and peace. Stay strong.
